- Your application for detailed site development plan (administrative modification) has been received and determined to be INCOMPLETE for the following reasons:

	1. Narrative of changes: Provide a narrative stating if parking, landscaping, or building areas will change. Include an existing vs. proposed comparison or list current quantities if remaining the same.
	2. Detailed site development plan: Provide a site plan, clouding any changes to landscaping, area, and parking. If unchanged, provide the previously approved quantities on the plan
	3. Proof of ownership: Submit a recorded warranty deed along with a certificate of formation or letter of authorization to confirm ownership and signatory authority.
	4. Submittal verification form: Submit a revised verification form or provide a letter of authorization to confirm the applicant's information.

Please upload revisions to the Accela Portal by October 13, to avoid expiration. Do not open or create a new case. Note: This is only a completeness check. Formal technical review begins once all documents are received and fees are paid.
